name: GS1 Digital Link Standard, URI Syntax 1.7.0
status: Release 1.7.0 ratified August 2026; the archive on ref.gs1.org lists "Published 7 August 2026".
relevance: The syntax "distinguishes between primary identification keys that express simple GS1 identifiers, such as GTIN and GLN" and key qualifiers and attributes; a GS1 Digital Link URI "is a particular form of URL". The standard says applications "SHALL NOT assume" that a URL in this syntax points to a resolver, and names a Resolver Description File as one test (section 2).

evidence.read: A rewrite of the relevance was proposed in issue #25 of this map's repository (2026-11-02) by Sven Böckelmann, who wrote: "Disclosure: Co-chair of the GS1 Visibility Standards (EPCIS/CBV) maintenance group; maintainer of OpenEPCIS; CTO at benelog GmbH & Co. KG, which sells EPCIS and Digital Link products." The relevance is written from the standard on ref.gs1.org, not from the text proposed in the issue.
